scoring_justification: T1 recompute from raw packing data is infeasible in the verifier sandbox; structural consistency of percolation curves and comparison of fractal dimensions to paper-reported values are used.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden thresholds for structural checks (percolation crossing p=0.65 ±0.05, max prob for chi0.9 <0.3, and fractal dimension targets D_bidispersed=1.86, D_random=1.896).
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Fig. 3, text describing percolation transition and fractal dimensions.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Inline values derived from paper's reported results.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are the paper's actual reported measurements; they serve as reference to verify the agent's reproduced structural properties.

outputs.description: Percolation curves for stoichiometry χ=0.5: connectedness probabilities of non-hexatic and hexatic subgraphs and size of largest connected component as functions of the non-hexatic fraction p=1-φ6.
Fractal dimension D fitted from cluster scaling at percolation threshold (p≈0.65) for the bidispersed packings (χ=0.5) and the random-site percolation model.

output_contract.notes: The solving agent is expected to generate the full ensemble of jammed packings and neighbor graphs; the percolation CSVs and fractal dimension are the scored deliverables. Checker will evaluate structural consistency (percolation threshold location, curve shape) and compare D values to hidden references.

steps.description: Percolation curve consistency for χ=0.5: percolation threshold location and end-point behavior.
Percolation curve shape for χ=0.1: eventual percolation at higher p.
Percolation curve for χ=0.9: no percolation, hexatic remains connected.
Fractal dimension agreement with paper values.
